label: defines
definition: A relation that holds between an operationally-defining feature (an environmental measurement axis or condition, or a structural / anatomical feature) and the trait class it parameterizes; asserts that the subject feature is the input dimension or distinguishing presence by which the object trait is operationally identified (e.g. "external pH axis defines pH phenotype with numerical limits", "outer membrane defines gram negative").
traits_addressed: covers 14 causal-graph edges: 12 environmental-axis → numerical-phenotype edges (delta/range/optimum graphs for pH, salinity, NaCl, oxygen, temperature) and 2 structural-feature → morphology-trait edges (outer membrane → gram negative; periplasmic flagella → axially filamented)
observations: operationally-definitional relation; no clean RO/Biolink home (biolink:has_phenotype is the wrong direction; biolink:related_to is too weak); distinct from `selects for` (METPO:2007401) which is evolutionary, not definitional
